description: The plot illustrates majority voting accuracy as a function of the number of samples (x-axis) for three series. The x-axis is labeled “Number of” (the remainder of the label is obscured) and uses a logarithmic base-2 scale with tick labels at \(2^0, 2^1, 2^2, 2^3, 2^4, 2^5, 2^6, 2^7,\) and \(2^8\). The y-axis is labeled “Majority voting accuracy,” appears linear, and spans roughly from 0.25 up to about 0.62, with visible tick marks at 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, and 0.6. One series is a dark blue solid line with circular markers that starts near 0.43 at \(2^0\), stays around 0.43 at \(2^1\), rises to about 0.49 at \(2^2\), about 0.54 at \(2^3\), about 0.57 at \(2^4\), about 0.59 at \(2^5\), about 0.60 at \(2^6\), and ends near 0.61 by \(2^8\). A second series is a green solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers that begins around 0.43 at \(2^0\)–\(2^1\), increases to about 0.50 at \(2^2\), about 0.54 at \(2^3\), about 0.57 at \(2^4\), about 0.59 at \(2^5\), about 0.60 at \(2^6\), and reaches roughly 0.61 by \(2^7\)–\(2^8\). The third series is a light blue solid line with circular markers that starts near 0.25 at \(2^0\)–\(2^1\), rises to about 0.30 at \(2^2\), about 0.35 at \(2^3\), about 0.39 at \(2^4\), about 0.41 at \(2^5\), about 0.42 at \(2^6\), and ends around 0.44 at \(2^8\); additionally, light green upward-triangle markers appear over this lower trajectory at several x-values (e.g., around 0.25 at \(2^1\), ~0.36 at \(2^3\), ~0.41 at \(2^5\), and ~0.44 at \(2^8\)).
